title: fix(clone): a labeled input-box rule reads focus-unrecognized, so say is withheld forever
description:
## symptom

`rhx clone say` to a live claude clone whose agent name is set (here `mechanic`) is withheld every time with `focus-unrecognized`. a healthy peer goes deaf. measured 2026-10-24 on rhachet@1.50.1, clone @:b7b35743, rhachet-roles-bhrain worktree `beav.fix-status-line-cpu`.

## cause, at the line

`dist/domain.operations/clone/screen/computeCloneInputState.js`, `isRuleRow`: `/^─+$/.test(line.trim())`.

claude code draws the agent name INTO the input box's top rule: `────────── mechanic ─`. that row fails the regex. `getInputBand` then lacks the top rule of the last pair: it returns null, or pairs the wrong rows. the classifier answers `unrecognized`, which has no force path.

the withheld hint then blames a permanent pty geometry fault and prescribes a teardown. that is false here.

## evidence

`.agent/.cache/repo=rhachet/skill=clone-say/debug.2026-10-24.log` in that worktree. the captured foot rows read:

```
────────────────────────────── mechanic ─
❯
─────────────────────────────────────────
```

## fix

let a rule row carry one trailed label, e.g. on the trimmed row: `/^─{20,}(\s+[^─\s][^─]*\s+─+)?$/`. a long run of rule glyphs, then one optional word group and a short tail. the half-width guard stays on the lead run.

## clamp

- a screen whose top rule reads `──…── mechanic ─`, above `❯` and a bare bottom rule → focus `input`, region `clear`. red today, green with the fix
- a short labeled divider (`── note ──`, under 20 glyphs) is still no rule
- a prose row that merely contains `─` is still no rule

## also

the `focus-unrecognized` hint names only the 0x0-geometry and detached-host causes, and calls the cause permanent. add the unmatched-rule cause, or drop the claim of permanence.
